message.content:
Here’s the exact API call you’d use:

```
GET https://api.zenrows.com/v1/comments?domain=microsoft.com&key=gamma_key&limit=20
```

This will fetch up to 20 comments for the domain **microsoft.com** using your key **gamma_key**.
